'''2015 San Diego Grand Prix Results Geoff Dearing LS You Can Either Profit By This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Geoff Dearing]] at [[2015 San Diego Grand Prix]] (Results).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Geoff Dearing]]
* '''Event:''' [[2015 San Diego Grand Prix]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open You Can Either Profit By This Deari.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Results
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2015-san-diego-grand-prix/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013130400/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2015-san-diego-grand-prix.html Internet Archive]
